originalScores.scale: Holistic subjective 0–10 for observed emulated mobile play: 0 unusable, 5 workable with substantial friction, 7 good with noticeable friction, 10 exceptional and consistently clear/comfortable in assessed scope. Wins and terminal score are not quality grades. Unassessed content receives no inferred enjoyment credit.

reasons.overallMobile: A coherent compact mission with strong atmosphere, understandable completion stages and useful touch assistance. View tracking, dense HUD and interrupted manual control coverage limit confidence.
reasons.controls: Two-contact MOVE/FIRE drag, scene turns and DASH registered. Tap aim made engagements approachable. Lost close charging target, several bursts used assist, continuous held-fire comfort and physical ergonomics unassessed.
reasons.gameplay: Receiver recovery, coil states, patrols and defended upload give progression and tactical demands. Offscreen attackers remained consequential. Assisted route dominated traversal; no claim of broad manual mastery or sustained enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Rain, wet reflections, teal lighting, large title and restrained terminal layout communicate a cohesive mood. Assessment limited to rendered stills and brief live inputs, without audio/performance certification.
reasons.usability: Map selection/route, clear contextual hold labels, objective checkmarks and explicit assisted stats help orient and confirm progress. Managing changing hold phases and rear threats adds friction.
reasons.readability: Primary health, ammo, objectives and terminal results read well. Secondary text, small distant patrol silhouettes and dark architectural surfaces need more effort at this viewport; controls occupy substantial lower screen area.
